name: MMBT3904
source: onsemi MMBT3904L データシート (MMBT3904LT1/D Rev. 15, 2026-09)
description: NPN 汎用トランジスタ (SOT-23, ピン1=B 2=E 3=C)。2N3904 の面実装版。データシート (onsemi) の表と代表特性から作った等価モデル
hfe_note: 表の hFE は min・max だけ (10 mA で 100〜300) なので、図 15 (VCE = 1 V、25 °C) の値をそのまま使いました。実物の hFE は個体で大きく違います。
remarks: read with `cargo run -p datasheet --example ds -- trace ... strokes` (the curves' vector lines in the PDF; the tick labels with minus signs given by position: `xt=` / `yt=`)
hfe_norm: Figure 15 (DC current gain, VCE = 1 V), the 25 C curve (the middle one) as hFE itself; the table: 40 (0.1 mA), 70 (1 mA), 100 to 300 (10 mA), 60 (50 mA), 30 (100 mA) min

vce_sat, vbe_sat: Figures 17 and 18 (IC/IB = 10), the 25 C curves (in the middle at large currents); vbe_on: Figure 19 (VCE = 1 V), 25 C. The table: VCE(sat) max 0.2 V (10 mA) and 0.3 V (50 mA), VBE(sat) 0.65 to 0.85 V (10 mA)
cibo, cobo: Figure 3 (Cibo to 6 V). The table: Cobo max 4 pF (5 V), Cibo max 8 pF (0.5 V)
ft_min: the table's fT min 300 MHz (no typ); hoe: the table's 1 to 40 umhos (1 mA, 10 V)

fit_nf: with NF fitted hFE stays within 5 % to 10 mA and VCE(sat) within 7 mV; the 200 mA point of Figure 15 (at the rated current, hFE 41) is left out, as for the 2N3904 (to 100 mA): Gummel-Poon cannot follow so steep a fall
